latest_release.name: v1.2.0
latest_release.body:
This release brings a new native macOS launcher, browser swipe navigation, and input source switching for Korean, Chinese and Japanese Macs 💻 You can upgrade by replacing the app with the new `TryOmarchy.dmg`. Your VM and its files are kept, and Omarchy inside the VM keeps updating with `omarchy update`. # Features * New native launcher that follows Light and Dark mode, laid out like System Settings with a sidebar by @themartiano in #364 * Two-finger swipes go back and forward in browsers, like on the Mac by @sscarduzio, @themartiano in #401, #412 * Caps Lock is the 한/영 key on Korean Macs by @AI-Dico, @themartiano in #404, #410 * Omarchy's input method follows the Mac's input source for Chinese and Japanese, and Globe switches it while the VM is focused by @themartiano in #411 * The launcher shows each step while preparing the Omarchy image, with a progress bar in place of the Launch button by @themartiano in #398, #413 # Fixes * The keyboard works in Limine's boot menu by @themartiano in #409 * ⌘C, ⌘V and ⌘W no longer type a plain key while the keyboard is captured by @stevederico in #279 * The guest clock recovers as soon as the Mac wakes, and the top bar clock redraws right away instead of up to a minute later by @themartiano in #391 * Bring back the battery percentage toggle in the Omarchy menu, after Omarchy split it into two rows by @themartiano in #408 ## Dev * Fix a QEMU crash when the Cocoa display starts a VM with no console by @charles-hood in #312 * Rewrite the docs around the shell principles, with a user manual, contributor docs and agent instructions by @themartiano in #395 * Improve the README by @themartiano
--- Full changelog: [v1.1.0...v1.2.0](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) Just download `TryOmarchy.dmg`, the rest of the installation will be handled automatically 👇
